name: Driving Simulator Paris
summary:
The dream drive through Paris, from the driver's seat.

YOUR GARAGE
You start in a luxury three-car garage: hex LED ceiling, oak wall, a supercar either side of you. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto your drive at Bercy.

DRIVE WITH YOUR HANDS
Put the controllers down and drive with hand tracking: close your fists on the wheel to steer, pinch to accelerate and brake. Pick a controller up any time and it takes over.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Work the stick through a real H-pattern, rev it to the shift
